_schema.id: S01, S02… (split as S05a/S05b, never renumber)
_schema.t: [start, end] in seconds; ends must chain and sum to runtime
_schema.maker: AI | AI + Remotion | Remotion | Higgsfield effect
_schema.point: feature/message number this shot carries (optional); point2 for a second
_schema.name: short shot name
_schema.frame: what we see, plain language (1–2 sentences)
_schema.sound: dialogue in CAPS NAME: "line" form + SFX/music notes
_schema.key_start: image prompt for the START frame (transformations only)
_schema.key: image prompt for the keyframe (or END frame when key_start exists)
_schema.motion: video prompt: one move, real speed, what stays rigid, duration, final state

shots.name: The lobby
shots.frame: Wide, 35mm, eye level. A glass-and-stone office lobby in Auckland's CBD, 8:52 am. Commuters with coffees cross the frame. Aroha and Josh walk in, a little overdressed. Josh carries a fat ring-binder labelled HOME LOAN, bristling with sticky notes.
shots.sound: Lobby hum, heels on stone, a distant coffee machine.
shots.key: Photoreal cinematic still, wide 35mm lens at eye level, modern glass and stone office tower lobby in Auckland CBD at 8:50am, soft morning light through tall windows, commuters with takeaway coffees crossing the frame slightly motion-blurred, a Māori woman about 31 [AROHA] and a Pākehā man about 33 [JOSH] walking toward camera slightly overdressed and nervous, he carries a thick ring-binder stuffed with papers and sticky notes. Natural colour, shallow depth of field, Kodak Vision3 film look, fine grain.
shots.motion: Static camera. Commuters cross in the foreground; the couple walk toward camera and slightly past it, toward the lifts. Natural walking pace, no slow motion. 3.5 seconds.

shots.name: Level 24
shots.frame: Insert. The lobby's digital directory screen: LEVEL 24 · HOME LENDING · 9:00 AM · A. NGATA & J. REID. Josh's finger taps it twice, nervously.
shots.remotion: SCR-Directory, corner-pinned onto the blank screen in the plate.
shots.key: Photoreal close-up of a sleek wall-mounted digital directory screen in an office lobby, the screen is plain flat mid-grey with no text, a man's index finger entering frame from the right about to tap it, shallow depth of field, soft lobby light, film grain.
shots.motion: The finger taps the blank screen twice. Almost static camera, gentle handheld breathing. 2.5 seconds.

shots.name: Going up
shots.frame: Inside the lift, looking out as the brushed-steel doors slide shut on the lobby. The couple stand side by side, reflected in the doors. The floor display above reads 1.
shots.sound: The doors whisper shut. The lift voice, calm and warm: “Going up.”
shots.key: [LIFT SET] Photoreal, camera inside a modern office lift at chest height facing the brushed-steel doors as they close on a bright lobby, [AROHA] and [JOSH] standing side by side facing the doors, he holds the thick ring-binder, their reflections soft in the steel, the floor display panel above the doors is black and blank. 35mm, natural light, film grain.
shots.motion: The lift doors slide closed from both sides. The couple exhale and settle. Static camera. 3 seconds.
